A passkey here is a passwordless sign-in method tied to this device and your account. You create one from [Settings](/Settings), and this app can then use it instead of a password.

You would use one so you can sign in without a password, and so the credential stays on this device rather than being something you type and reuse. [Settings](/Settings) is where you add and manage passkeys and linked accounts. I can take you there, or add a passkey on this device if you want.
I'll update your profile time zone to Africa/Nairobi.

The profile save lives on [Profile](/Profile), not this Counter page. Open that page and try the save again, or tell me the error text plus the display name and time zone you wanted and I can retry the update for you.

If it fails again, file it on [Feedback](/Feedback). I can take you to Profile if you want.

A passkey is a passwordless sign-in credential stored on this device and tied to your account. You prove it is you with the device (often a PIN or biometric) instead of typing a password, and the site never stores a reusable password.

Here, adding one lets you sign back in with that device. You manage passkeys and linked accounts on [Settings](/Settings). I can open that page or start adding a passkey on this device if you want.
